name: general
description: A neutral starting point for any collection of notes: every specific claim, joined by names, dates, places and numbers. Copy this folder to begin a pack for your own field.

extraction.audience: a research tool for someone working from their own notes
extraction.kindNotes: "definition" = what a term or thing is said to mean; "decision" = something that was decided, ruled or agreed, and by whom; "opinion" = a view the note attributes to someone.
extraction.categoryExample: so "Mercury" the planet and "Mercury" the company differ: place vs organisation
